summary: Implemented draft-model two-batch overlap for fixed-width EAGLE/NextN draft-extend forwards. The draft worker now installs a TBO attention wrapper only for supported eager DeepSeek NextN + segmented-A2A configurations; draft-extend metadata and EagleDraftExtendInput are split losslessly; the NextN MoE layer executes the two children through the TBO operation pipeline; DSA seed-topk capture is preserved; idle-rank collective symmetry and prefill/decode phase separation are guarded. Also fixed the upstream WIP's known startup assertion by passing the runner-owned attention backend into batch preparation instead of resolving a forward-context backend during ForwardBatch initialization.

tests.what_was_measured: 24 deterministic split-math, metadata round-trip, adversarial field-classification, gate, out-of-forward-context regression, operation-order, and DSA seed capture tests passed.

51 related TBO/speculative tests plus 7 subtests passed, covering compatibility with existing batch-overlap paths and Eagle backend setup. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e5851e1fea51/evidence/unit-related-fixed.log

On AMD Instinct MI355X, 21 GPU rows at width 3 were split and recombined exactly against independent torch slicing; child-B flat pointers matched independently constructed references; child capture-buffer view writes exactly reconstructed the parent buffer (max_abs_error=0). Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e5851e1fea51/evidence/gpu-numerical-reference.log

Collected the three new 4-GPU DeepEP/MTP end-to-end checks: gate banner, forward-mode split census, and GSM8K accuracy/accept-length regression. The tests were not executed because only one GPU was assigned.
All repository formatting, lint, conflict, secret, test-taxonomy, and registered-test checks passed.

gpu_execution_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950, unique ID 0x89e8c5cd3767811a) executed the independent GPU numerical reference successfully; raw output is retained at /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e5851e1fea51/evidence/gpu-numerical-reference.log.
remaining_limitations: The feature is intentionally limited to DeepseekV3ForCausalLMNextN draft workers using a non-none speculative MoE A2A backend, eager draft-extend execution (SGLANG_DISABLE_DRAFT_EXTEND_CUDA_GRAPH=1), no prefill context parallelism, and fixed-width non-widened EagleDraftExtendInput.
Draft-extend CUDA graph replay with TBO children is not implemented.
Multi-layer/widened draft inputs (num_front_tokens > 0) are rejected because their row width differs from num_tokens_per_req.

The required DeepEP integration test needs four GPUs and the DeepSeek-V3 target/NextN draft model weights. This job was assigned one GPU and no qualifying model weights, so the transport-level split census, GSM8K semantic accuracy, accept length, idle-rank distributed collective behavior, and throughput improvement were not executed here. The deterministic tiny Llama fixture cannot qualify DeepSeek NextN architecture, segmented A2A, or a distributed workload, so it was not substituted.
No native C++/FlyDSL sources changed, repository-environment.json declares native=null, and therefore no native rebuild was applicable.
